subject: Error when using categorical variable as dependent variable and WLSMV estimator

messages.author: ce14e9835305239f
messages.subject: Error when using categorical variable as dependent variable and WLSMV estimator
parts:
Hello, I have a problem when declaring dependent variable 'status' as binary with WLSMV estimator, following is my code and lavaan warning of not being able to compute standard errors. Anyone has an idea about it? Thank you.

semmodel <-'CB=~status
HD=~dmf2+dmf3+dmf4+dmf8
MC=~dmf5+dmf6+dmf7

#direct effects
CB~c*impulse+d*age+e*lnincome+f*lcs1+g*education+h*lnAmount+n*residence+p*gender+a*dependents+b*employment
impulse~j*HD+k*MC

#mediation
jc:= j*c
kc:= k*c'

fit.semmodel<- sem(semmodel, data=data, ordered=TRUE, estimator ="WLSMV",mimic= "Mplus")
summary(fit.semmodel,  fit.measures=TRUE, standardized=TRUE, rsq=TRUE)


Warning messages: 1: In lav_model_vcov(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats, : lavaan WARNING: Could not compute standard errors! The information matrix could not be inverted. This may be a symptom that the model is not identified. 2: In lav_test_satorra_bentler(lavobject = NULL, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats, : lavaan WARNING: could not invert information matrix needed for robust test statistic
